body:
## Issue

Fixes #260 - Turn the user menu into a shared Menu with hover highlighting

## What

The user menu is built from the shared Menu and its Menu Item components, showing hover highlighting on one item at a time. This change implements the redesigned User Menu from the design consistency pass.

## Changes Made

1. **Updated HomePage.tsx** (apps/web/src/features/home/HomePage.tsx:59-65)
   - Changed MenuItem to use `size="compact"` to match the redesigned Menu Item component
   - Updated icon size from 16px to 14px to match the compact Menu Item specification
   
2. **Added hover highlighting test** (apps/web/e2e/user-menu.spec.ts:84-106)
   - Test verifies that when hovering over "Sign out", it shows the highlighted state
   - Confirms only one item is highlighted at a time

## Testing

All tests pass including:
- ✓ Given I am signed in as Mara Reyes, when I open the user card's menu, then I see "Mara Reyes", my email and "Sign out" (apps/web/e2e/user-menu.spec.ts:3)
- ✓ Given the user menu is open, when I hover "Sign out", then only "Sign out" is highlighted (apps/web/e2e/user-menu.spec.ts:84)

The implementation matches the design specification (design/tempo.pen#f1j6n for User Menu, design/tempo.pen#ZsXwz for Menu Item):
- User menu width: 236px ✓
- Menu padding: 6px ✓
- Menu corner radius: 10px ✓
- Menu Item size: compact with 14px icons ✓
- Menu Item padding: 7px vertical, 9px horizontal ✓
- Menu Item corner radius: 6px ✓
- Menu Item gap: 9px ✓
- Hover state shows bg-bg background ✓

## Verification

bash .github/scripts/verify.sh passes:
- ✓ test (15 passed)
- ✓ conventions
- ✓ lint

Fixes #260
title: Turn the user menu into a shared Menu with hover highlighting
